label: belgium-feb-may
_why: Does the Feb->May direction help? Supply-share substitution is not instant, so a calculation fed February supply may describe a later month's demand better. Four monthly snapshots in ONE run, each pairing that month's pops, SoLs, supply and order book - so the comparison is strictly within-run and within-instant, and any movement is the game's own settling rather than run divergence.
_note: pop_sol now rides phase 0 with the market goods so pops and orders are read at the SAME tick. It was phase 2, which paired February pops with April orders.
